steps.label: Find a×b
steps.margin_note: First mark. Both vectors lie flat in the xy-plane, so the cross product points purely along k — the i and j components vanish.
steps.memory_tip: Both vectors lie flat in the xy-plane, so the cross product points purely along k.

recall.must_convey: That the cross product is computed and comes to 41k, with zero i and j components.
accept: cross them and only the k component survives, forty one k
both are in the xy plane so the cross product is along k, forty one k
the cross product is forty one k
rendu xy plane lo unnai kabatti k direction lo, forty one k
compute a cross b, it comes to forty one k

steps.why: A cross product is perpendicular to both factors. Two vectors lying flat in the xy-plane can only have a perpendicular pointing straight up or down it.
common_mistakes: Omitting the zero k components and misaligning the determinant.

steps.label: Halve the magnitude
steps.margin_note: Second mark. Triangle, so halve. |41k| is just 41 — a vector along one axis has magnitude equal to its coefficient.
steps.memory_tip: Triangle, so halve. |41k| is just 41 — a vector along one axis has that magnitude.

recall.must_convey: That the triangle area is half the magnitude, giving 41/2 = 20.5 square units.
accept: half of forty one is twenty point five square units
the area is forty one over two which is twenty point five

steps.why: The half is what distinguishes a triangle from the parallelogram on the same two sides.
common_mistakes: Trying to take a square root of 41k.
